text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Mmm~~!
Today's training... really took a lot out of me...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... Once I get out, I gotta do my homework...
And think about... the town revival... too...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
(Um... what was it again...?
Without the reference materials, I just don't know...
Ahh... so warm...)

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: ...Tomorrow will do, I suppose.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: *Gulp, gulp, gulp............!*

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Puhaah! Why didn't I
ever think of this before...?!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer!
Listen, I came up with a great idea
for the town revitalization!

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, is something up?
You look awfully refreshed today♪

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe...
It just came to me all of a sudden...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Maybe leaving things "just as they are" is for the best.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: "Aand, we're back again today~♪ Yukoma Onsen..."

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
No, I don't need to be on camera...
I don't need narration either.
I'll just add captions later.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: "Hokko Tarumae's Yukoma Onsen Recuperation Routine."

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to show how I usually recuperate here,
from my own perspective.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Rather than a catchy hook,
I thought saying, 'Here's how you can relax~'
...might resonate better.
choice_data_list: I see, that might be true.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
Well then, I'm going for a walk along my usual route.
Oh, would you like to come along?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And with that,
I ended up tagging along with Hokko Tarumae.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
(Tip-tap-tap... tip-tap-tap...)
(Whooooosh)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
(Splash, splash... splash, splash...)
(Chirp, chirp, chirp... whoooosh...)

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Yes, that's all for today's photoshoot.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
—Good morning.
Thanks for yesterday.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Breakfast...
looks delicious again today~♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hokko Tarumae spent her day casually, occasionally filming on a whim.
And then—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
—Editing complete.
Done already.
I can totally work on this while on the move.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"Publish"—and done!
I hope it gets a good response♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And one week later—

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, is this the one?
It's lovely. It's so fun seeing places I know on screen~♪

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, seeing it in a video feels fresh, doesn't it?
I'm glad it looks like it was captured nicely.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Um... and the thing is,
compared to the other promo videos,
the view count is abnormally high...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Could there be... a miscount or something...?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Nah, no way.
Hey, lemme see those analytics for a sec?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"—Ahhh, right, right.
A phenomenal repeat rate.
It's gotta be that."

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
You know how campfire videos and
walking videos are a thing?
I'm guessing it's popular in that kind of way.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Ah...!
I always end up watching that.
It's great to have on while working, too.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Campfires and taking walks...?
Is that really fun to watch on TV?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, it's not so much about enjoying it as using it for BGM?
Plus, even when I can't be bothered,
it makes me feel like I actually got something done.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I see...!
You did mention it was 'too much of a hassle to go,' after all.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Attention and name recognition are steadily growing.
Just one more push...!

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
No, no, it is more than sufficient.
It looks like it will place little burden on Lady Tarumae,
so I am relieved.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Ah, sorry for worrying you back then.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"Right now, I'm making sure to rest properly too.
Or rather, thanks to you,
I've gotten a lot better at switching gears!"

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
My, oh my♪ That must be
thanks to spacing out in the hot springs.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Spaced out...?

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text: You can't bring anything into the bath, can you? All you can do is soak in the hot water with just yourself.

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
So no matter how busy someone is,
they automatically switch to "off" mode.

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
According to the proprietress, once you clear away
all that "brain fatigue," inspiration just
goes "ding!" and strikes you right away♪

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: I see, no wonder...!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu!
Maybe I'll space out even more then!

text_block_list.name: Tourist A
text_block_list.text:
—Oh, my, are you a girl who runs in races?
Say, do you know an Umamusume who spent time here long ago?
She was very strong at Kokura...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that person.
The one who dedicated herself to research here
as a hot spring cure trial participant after retiring...

text_block_list.name: Tourist A
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, is that true?
I had no idea about that part!
As expected, you're quite knowledgeable!"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
No, it just happened by chance.
While resting, I had plenty of free time, so I frequented a nearby library
and ended up learning all kinds of things.

text_block_list.name: Tourist B
text_block_list.text:
Huh, the library. Maybe I'll go too.
A girl I used to support was at a hot spring cure,
and I really wanna know more about it~.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
(I see... As expected, there are a lot
of race fan customers here...)

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: (Then wouldn't that kind of topic... be something everyone's interested in?)

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Ah, I floated up again—!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—One day, after getting out of the bath,
I spotted an interesting display in a corner of the rest area.
choice_data_list: 'Famous Uma Musume with Ties to Hot Springs'...?

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
It's amazing, isn't it...!
Tarumae-sama made it for us.
Even the head librarian gave it glowing praise.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Not only does it list major race wins, a chronological timeline, and awards... it even includes comments for tourists, recommended hot springs, and souvenirs!
choice_data_list: That's an incredible amount of information……!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much.
Actually, when I sent a DM on Umastagram,
I was able to get an interview too.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I was just hoping to hear even a single comment from them in person...
but everyone shared their memories with me in such rich detail!

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
"Takes me back.
Everyone looks like they're doing well."

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
"I'll never forget the duet with the proprietress in the banquet hall. Who knew you could sing so well? lol"
...it says. Tee-hee.

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
Geez, that kid, huh?
She kept insisting she wanted to practice for the concert,
so I didn't have much of a choice but to go along with it.

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text: That's the spirit of hospitality, indeed.

text_block_list.name: Tourist C
text_block_list.text: Ooh, that's fascinating! I actually watched this race live back in the day~.

text_block_list.name: Tourist D
text_block_list.text:
Waaah~, this is nice.
Just chilling on a bench and spacing out after a hot bath.
I could do this forever~.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
...!
Ehehe, please take a good, long look♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And a few days later...!

text_block_list.name: Sash-Wearing Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Proprietress~~! Long time no see!
I'm back~~~♪

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text: Oh, you're...!

text_block_list.name: Sash-Wearing Umamusume
text_block_list.text: We heard our exhibit's making waves! Plus, we wanted to hit the hot springs too♪

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Whoa...! Thank you very much
for your cooperation!

text_block_list.name: Sash-Wearing Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
No worries, it's all for the sake of Yukoma Hot Springs.
A crisis is just an opportunity waiting to happen!
Now's the time to spread the word about how important rest and recuperation are!

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
My, my, you certainly haven't changed a bit.
Still as much of a maverick as ever, I see.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Thanks to the hot topic of famous Umamusume associated with hot springs,
the comments also began to change—"

text_block_list.name: Man A
text_block_list.text:
Must be nice, an exhibition.
I wanna read through it in person.
Then soak in a hot spring, drink some beer...♪

text_block_list.name: Woman A
text_block_list.text:
Maybe I should go too...
I've got paid leave saved up...
Once in a while wouldn't hurt!

text_block_list.name: Viewer Comment
text_block_list.text:
"I wanna see the exhibit~!"
"Oh yeah, taking time off work ＼(^o^)／"
"Just booked the hotel. Can't wait~!"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
...!
Alright... There we go...!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, have you seen this video?
The "Demon of Kokura" was in it the other day~!
Doing a hot spring cure experience as a model and all~!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
I totally watched it! I was watching it in bed all Sunday.
Man, I seriously wanna go there.
choice_data_list: Sounds like it's become quite the rumor.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Hasn't the tide started to turn?
The wind is shifting...!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Aah... Yes, yes! I love this feeling that something's about to happen!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"I wanna do something too~!
No way I'm gonna miss out on such a fun moment!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Transcend seemed unable to contain her restlessness.
It was as if she had far too much energy to burn...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Perhaps this is the effect of the recuperation as well. I secretly thought to myself—
